---
name: "Route Approved Work"
description: "Route an approved issue through the governed agent lifecycle and prepare bounded handoffs."
argument-hint: "Provide the approved issue and task-contract reference"
agent: "MVP Engineering Orchestrator"
---

Read the agent registry, routing matrix, activation policy, and active task
contract. Select only invocable agents, explain the matching route, preserve
implementer-reviewer separation, and identify every human gate. Prepare the next
bounded handoff with inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria, and evidence. Stop at
approval, merge, deployment, or any decision reserved for the Product Owner.
